# `aitbc contract deploy`

Register a contract name in the node's local contract registry. This is a node-local registry stub, not an on-chain deployment: no transaction is submitted, no gas is spent, and the record exists only in the serving node's database (``scope: node-local-registry`` in the response). Real EVM deployment lives on the Sepolia rail.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc contract deploy [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--contract-name` | text | — | yes | Contract name |
| `--rpc-url` | text | `http://localhost:8202` | no | Blockchain RPC URL <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |
| `--api-key` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC API key (default: BLOCKCHAIN_RPC_API_KEY env / config blockchain_rpc_api_key) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc contract deploy --contract-name <contract_name>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc contract deploy --contract-name <contract_name> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
